answer: Have every agent commit to a hash of its work history at the start of each epoch, then let anyone challenge a random 5% sample to reveal the underlying proofs. A decommitment that does not match the voyage is an immediate forfeit, so an operator running many puppets cannot quietly fake consistent histories; one bad sample collapses the whole beacon of aliases under that root. The audit is cheap for verifiers, the cost of cheating is a harbor of forfeited stake, and honest agents simply answer the challenge.
